aggregation.close: last tick in minute and side
aggregation.high: maximum tick in minute and side
aggregation.low: minimum tick in minute and side
aggregation.open: first tick in minute and side

comparison_mask.canonical_m1_ignoreFlats: canonical provider notes indicate ignoreFlats=false for M1 acquisition; audit preserves flats and reports no-tick minutes separately
comparison_mask.timestamps: exact common UTC minute timestamps after boundary exclusions

flat_tick_policy: preserve flat ticks; canonical ignoreFlats interaction reported

intervals.partial_first_last_minutes: excluded from equality summary, reported separately
intervals.tick_on_minute_boundary: belongs to minute starting at that timestamp

missing_side: side-specific generated bar missing; classify separately
no_tick_minutes: do not forward fill; classify missing tick-derived bars

ordering.out_of_order_ticks: count and sort stably before aggregation

quantization.method: round(price * scale) to integer raw points before comparison

utc_policy.friday_close: classified by UTC timestamp; no local-time conversion
utc_policy.sunday_open: classified by UTC timestamp; no local-time conversion

zero_volume: preserve if present; not used for OHLC equality
